name: Spontaneous Conversion (Ki)
body:
You are able to unravel and re-weave the patterns of magic to suit your needs of the moment.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Wis 13, Cha 13, ki pool class feature or Ki Meditation, ability to prepare spells.

Benefit(s): As a standard action, you can convert the magical energies of a prepared spell and convert it into a different spell you know of the same level or lower by spending a number of points from your ki pool equal to the spell’s level. You can modify this spell with any metamagic feats you know, following the rules for spontaneous casting and metamagic, as long as the total adjusted level does not exceed the level of the spell you are converting.
